svg.text: Hyper-MML with soft-computing additions: detailed architecture
one training sample = three modality nodes; grey = base Hyper-MML component, white with bold border = added in this work, dashed = computed offline
PSO (swarm) tunes lr · L2 · dropout · #hypergraph layers L · similarity width σ · reduct size k · aux weight λ fitness = validation F1, swarm evaluated in parallel
EEG E ∈ R^(C×L) (EAV: 30 ch × 500 samples @100 Hz)
FFT → 5 bands (δ θ α β γ)
released code: run offline, trained checkpoint not public
(our AFFEC runs: log band-power, 63 ch × 5 bands = 315-d)
width σ, min t-norm over B
EEG node also gets a speaker
Inputs f_EEG, f_AUD, f_VID ∈ R^512 (per sample)
9 TSK rules, firing φ_ij = μ_i(c)·μ_j(g) (product t-norm)
Defuzzify: w_m = Σ φ_ij σ(t_ij) / Σ φ_ij
weighted average of rule outputs, in (0,1)
w̃_m = 3 w_m / Σ_k w_k f_m ← w̃_m · f_m
interpretable: per-class trust and rule table
Auxiliary loss on the three aux heads
L_aux = mean_m NLL(softmax(W_m f_m), y), weight λ
hypergraph of one conversation (N = 3 segments shown)
dashed ovals: N intra-segment hyperedges {e_i, a_i, v_i}
solid ovals: 3 inter-segment hyperedges (one modality over time)
released loader: N = 1 (each sample is its own conversation)
V⁽ˡ⁾ = σ( D_V⁻¹ H W_e D_E⁻¹ Hᵀ V⁽ˡ⁻¹⁾ )
learnable node weights α and hyperedge weights β
fc 512 → 512, residual optional, K = 0 extra graph convs
(code: one linear layer; paper describes a 2-layer MLP)
EAV: 5 classes; AFFEC felt valence: 3 classes
L = Σ w_i c(y_i) NLL_i / Σ w_i c(y_i) + λ L_aux
w_i from rough boundary region: w = 0.3 + 0.7·norm(μ_POS)
c(y): class weights; Adam, lr 1e-4, L2, 30 epochs
validation F1 on a trial-grouped 20 % of the training trials
→ report test F1 at that epoch (never the max test F1)
reducts, weights and imputation: fitted on training data only
1. split trials 80 / 20 into train and test, then cut windows
2. validation = 20 % of train trials, kept together per trial
3. fit reducts + boundary weights on remaining train windows
4. train 30 epochs; keep epoch with best validation F1
5. 5 seeds per configuration; paired tests vs baseline
C, L: EEG channels, samples; K: classes; N: segments
f_m: 512-d feature of modality m; c_m, g_m: certainty, agreement
R_a(x,y) = max(0, 1 − |a(x) − a(y)|/σ); γ_B: dependency degree
σ(·): sigmoid (gate) / non-linearity (conv); λ: aux-loss weight
